status_semantics: No field named status. This record holds the truth set and the measured result used to validate dec_extractor_v1 before bulk execution.

truth_set_provenance.origin: The 36 legible page values read manually during the Phase A constancy block, recorded in PHASE_A_CONSTANCY_RESULT_v1.json.
truth_set_provenance.selection_rule: The preregistered first, middle and last DATA_PAGE of each in-window run, fixed in PHASE_A_SAMPLING_RULE_v1.json before any value was viewed.
truth_set_provenance.independence: The selection rule is independent of D2 eligibility and of any pipeline behaviour. The truth values existed before the extractor was written.
truth_set_provenance.reading_method: Masked visual reading of the declination crop, presented in composites.
truth_set_provenance.declared_weakness: The truth values were read by eye. An error in a truth value would appear below as agreement rather than as a detected fault.

measurement_scope.band: The mid-page rows y 690 to 840, being the band from which the manual truth was read.
measurement_scope.page_value_rule: The page value produced by the extractor is the most frequent TRANSCRIBED row value within that band. Pages with no TRANSCRIBED row in the band yield no value.

result.failure_mode: ABSTENTION_NOT_ERROR. The extractor produced no incorrect value on this set. Where it is unsure it declines, which is visible in the output, rather than emitting a plausible wrong digit, which would not be.

what_this_does_not_establish: Accuracy across the full population. All 36 pages come from folders 012, 013 and 014.
Accuracy on damaged pages, faint printing, sideways printing or the other layout variants documented in the archive notes.

Accuracy near the sealed B1 boundary specifically, which matters more than the average. Every record inside or near the boundary receives direct source-image verification regardless of extractor confidence.
